meta.title: Explainer v3 checkpoint
meta.subtitle: Progress of milestone 1 of the visual-explainer v3 effort: the report page and the screenshots are in, the snapcn video is in progress.

summary: `render.mjs` writes the report page (`index.html`) and the concept graph (`graph.html`). `shoot.mjs` takes one PNG for each report section. The snapcn video and the GitHub media upload are not done yet.

tldr.changed: the report page replaces the graph as `index.html`; the graph moves to `graph.html`.
tldr.lookFirst: the sequence diagram in change 2 and the short Done when table.
tldr.risk: low so far; the video phases can still change the narration format.

changes.how: `report.mjs` renders the props top to bottom into `template/report.html`: TL;DR, Done when, changes, findings, hand test, rollback.
changes.why: A reviewer reads the page in reading order; the graph stays one link away.

changes.how: `shoot.mjs` drives a headless Chrome over CDP and writes one PNG for each `data-shot` element.
changes.why: GitHub reviews show the sections as images.

delivered.criterion: The report renders both examples with every section.
delivered.result: Both examples render; the test checks the data-shot ids.

delivered.criterion: The page is readable at 360 px with no page scroll.
delivered.result: Tables stack and diagrams scroll inside their box.

delivered.criterion: A Done when table or hand test longer than 8 rows stays short.
delivered.result: Not met rows first, the rest in a collapsed block.

delivered.criterion: `shoot.mjs` writes one PNG per section in light and dark.
delivered.result: PNG files for each data-shot id; a failed cache Chrome gives way to the next.

delivered.criterion: The architecture arrows do not cross boxes.
delivered.result: Arrows run in the bands between rows; one long label still overlaps a line.

delivered.criterion: The video has one scene for each report section.
`gh-media.mjs` uploads the shots to the media branch.
pr-review posts the shots in its review.
loop-execute runs a checkpoint every 5 phases.
SKILL.md describes the report, the shots and the video.

handTest.title: Render the example plan
handTest.why: Run it on the integration branch. It prints the paths of index.html and graph.html.
handTest.expect: Open `/tmp/ve-plan/index.html`: the report, with a link to the graph at the end.

handTest.title: Take the screenshots
handTest.why: The script finds Chrome by itself; pass `--chrome` to choose one.
handTest.expect: One PNG path per line, starting with page.png.

rollback.step: Nothing is merged yet. Delete the integration branch to drop the work.
